+def test_send_streaming_denial_response(test_client_factory: TestClientFactory) -> None:
+    background_calls = 0
+
+    async def background() -> None:
+        nonlocal background_calls
+        background_calls += 1
+
+    async def app(scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:
+        websocket = WebSocket(scope, receive=receive, send=send)
+        await websocket.receive()
+        response = StreamingResponse(
+            iter((b"streamed ", b"denial")),
+            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
+            background=BackgroundTask(background),
+        )
+        await websocket.send_denial_response(response)
+
+    client = test_client_factory(app)
+    with pytest.raises(WebSocketDenialResponse) as exc:
+        with client.websocket_connect("/"):
+            pass  # pragma: no cover
+    assert exc.value.status_code == status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED
+    assert exc.value.content == b"streamed denial"
+    assert background_calls == 1
+
+
+def test_send_file_denial_response(tmp_path: Path, test_client_factory: TestClientFactory) -> None:
+    path = tmp_path / "denial.txt"
+    path.write_bytes(b"file denial")
+
+    async def app(scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:
+        websocket = WebSocket(scope, receive=receive, send=send)
+        await websocket.receive()
+        response = FileResponse(path, status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN)
+        await websocket.send_denial_response(response)
+
+    client = test_client_factory(app)
+    with pytest.raises(WebSocketDenialResponse) as exc:
+        with client.websocket_connect("/"):
+            pass  # pragma: no cover
+    assert exc.value.status_code == status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN
+    assert exc.value.content == b"file denial"
+
